title: 证据掩码驱动组合泛化：六十分组预注册验证
summary: 该预注册研究用60个共享冻结语言模型主干、通过连续数据包通信的四单元系统，验证证据掩码对组合泛化的影响。掩码在二、三操作组合上准确率中位数提升0.846和0.859，全部12对均达标，行为准则通过。但角色信息作用与中介归因仍待解。
summary_en: A preregistered sixty-society study tests whether evidence masking improves compositional generalization in systems sharing a frozen LM backbone and communicating via learned continuous packets. Masking raised held-out two- and three-operation accuracy by median paired differences of 0.846 and 0.859, with all twelve pairs clearing margins and the full behavioral criterion passing. Role-information effects and mediation remain unresolved.
